title: Bijoe Emmanuel v. State of Kerala

content.caseIdentity: Bijoe Emmanuel v. State of Kerala, (1986) 3 SCC 615
content.holding: Expulsion of Jehovah's Witness children for not singing National Anthem violates Article 19(1)(a) and 25(1); standing respectfully is not disrespect.
content.relevance: Freedom of conscience and National Anthem.
